values.alarm_description: COST-1: the burstable host is nearly out of CPU credits (standard mode: it will be held at its baseline, never billed for surplus). Sustained route-heavy play or a runaway process; see the host sampler's load. EXPECTED once after every launch or replacement: T4g/T3 in standard mode get no launch credits, so the balance starts near 0 and this alarm clears after ~75 min of light load.

COST-1: a financial / security incident counter fired (task loss, uncertain store, refused start, money sweep failure, relayer takeover not taken, KMS failure, money game held journal-ahead). See the log group.
COST-1: the single host's game server is unhealthy or silent for 3 minutes (HostHealthProblems >= 1, or no status tick at all). See the log group's task-status lines for which problem.
COST-1: the host sampler saw memory, swap or disk pressure, or a new OOM kill (gs-host-sample). See /var/log/gs-measure on the host.
COST-1: the EC2 instance or system status check failed (automatic recovery handles hardware; this says it happened).

public_ip.description: The origin hostname's A record must name this (owner DNS action, migration step G).

app_role_arn.description: The host's app role: stacks/ledger `app_runtime_role_arns` must list it (ledger table + KMS key policies).

architecture.description: The image platform the host needs (linux/<architecture>).

instance_id.description: The host (operator scripts address it by id through SSM Run Command).

origin_hostname.description: What the existing CloudFront distribution's /gs* origin must name (stacks/app edge.alb_origin_domain_name).

public_ip.description: The Elastic IP: the A record of `origin_hostname` must name it (an owner DNS action at migration).

runtime_parameter_arn.description: The runtime document this host's server reads (written by stacks/app for pool `pool`).

description.constant_value: AWS public endpoints, Juno REST endpoints, ACME, package repositories
ACME HTTP-01 only - Caddy challenge or 404 on port 80
EMERGENCY EC2 Instance Connect only; remove after use
HTTPS from CloudFront origin-facing servers only

acme_email.description: Optional contact address for Let's Encrypt expiry notices. Null: none is sent (no address is ever invented).

alarm_action_arns.description: Where the five alarms notify (SNS topics etc., created elsewhere). Empty is valid: the alarms still evaluate.

allowed_origins.description: GS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: the exact https origins the browser uses (e.g. https://play.example.org).

budget.description:
The account's monthly AWS Budget (COST-1 Part 15). Created only when `enabled` and at least one subscriber is named
(AWS requires one per notification; no address is ever invented). Thresholds: $15 actual, $20 actual, $25 forecast,
$25 actual, $30 actual (the hard ceiling).

caddy_image.description: The Caddy image, pinned by its multi-arch INDEX digest (public.ecr.aws mirror of the official image).

container_port.description: The game server's port inside its container; published on the host's LOOPBACK only.

ecr_keep_images.description: How many images the ECR lifecycle policy keeps (release history for rollback; ~0.1 GB each).

ecr_repository_name.description: The EXISTING ECR repository the host pulls from (stacks/app's gs-<environment>-server). Null: that convention.

edge_diagnostic_staging.description: LIVE-6 L6-6's staging edge mirror (/gs/diag/edge, GS_EDGE_DIAGNOSTIC=staging) for the edge certification probes through CloudFront. Refused in prod* environments here; the server also refuses it beside a mainnet escrow.

emergency_ssh_cidrs.description: EMERGENCY ONLY, default empty (no port 22 at all): at most two /32 operator addresses for EC2 Instance Connect. Remove again after use.

environment.description: The environment label (the runtime document's `environment`; resources are named gs-<environment>-...).

escrow_enabled.description: Whether the runtime document carries escrow (the host role then reads /gs/<environment>/juno-backend).

game_generations.description: Every MANAGED game-table generation the app role may reach (stacks/app `game_generations`): a restore's g<N+1> is listed before the host restarts onto it.

generation.description: The SERVING game-table generation (gs-<environment>-game-g<generation>), as in stacks/app.

instance.description:
The ONE application host.
  type            t4g.small (the default and the budget's target: 2 GB, Graviton); t4g.micro only after the memory
                  measurement plan says so; t3.small / t3.micro are the x86 fallback (COST_BUDGET.json allow-list)
  ami_id          an Amazon Linux 2023 AMI of the type's architecture, pinned (a change REPLACES the host)
  root_volume_gb  gp3, encrypted
  swap_mb         a swap file (a safety net for the measurement window, not capacity)
  server_memory   the game-server container's memory limit (docker --memory)

ledger_table_arn.description: The ledger table's ARN (stacks/ledger output). Cross-account: the ledger stack must authorise THIS host's role (`app_runtime_role_arns`).

log_retention_days.description: CloudWatch Logs retention of the host's log group (the AUDIT and metric lines). The budget allows at most 90.

manage_ecr_lifecycle.description: Attach a lifecycle policy to the existing repository (keep the newest `ecr_keep_images` images; untagged after 7 days). OFF by default: turn it on only once the ECS services are gone (SINGLE_HOST_MIGRATION.md step I) -- while ECS is the rollback path, its circuit-breaker images must not expire.

money_tables_nonmainnet.description: Sets ESCROW_MONEY_TABLES=nonmainnet (money tables on a non-mainnet escrow only; the runtime refuses mainnet).

network.description:
The host's network: ONE public subnet (a route to an internet gateway) of an existing VPC. No NAT, no endpoints.
  vpc_id             the VPC
  subnet_id          a public subnet
  juno_egress_ports  TCP ports of the Juno REST endpoints besides 443 (default none)

origin_hostname.description: The public DNS name CloudFront uses as the /gs* origin (e.g. gs-origin.example.org). It must resolve to this host's Elastic IP (an owner DNS action at migration time); Caddy obtains its certificate for it from Let's Encrypt (HTTP-01 on port 80).

pool.description: The ONE pool this host serves (its runtime document is /gs/<environment>/runtime/<pool>). The single host keeps the certified pool-writer fence: a second process or host taking this pool fences the first.

signing_keys.description: The KMS signing keys the escrow configuration names (relayer, settlement, admission), by key ARN; null without escrow. The host role may GetPublicKey and Sign (ECDSA_SHA_256 over a DIGEST) with exactly these.

ssm_agent.description: Grant the SSM agent its minimum (Session Manager and Run Command over the public SSM endpoints; free on EC2). The operator workflow (gs-host.ps1) uses Run Command; there is no SSH.

termination_protection.description: EC2 termination protection: a host replacement is a deliberate two-step change (turn this off, then apply).

trusted_proxy_hops.description: GS_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS: CloudFront + Caddy = 2 (the same count as CloudFront + ALB, so the edge proof carries over).

app_account_id.description: The account these credentials must be (explicit: a wrong profile refuses the plan).

region.description: The app account's region (the runtime document's `region`).
